methodology: We analyzed 100+ Reddit posts and comments across r/Nigeria, r/nigerianfood, and r/NaijaRestaurantReview spanning 2020 to 2026. Suya spots were ranked by frequency of independent recommendations. Every spot was validated against local food blogs (Makele’s Mouthful, BusinessDay, FoodieInLagos) and verified with Google Places API data for ratings and current operating status.
